jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE corrected textile-factory game sprite at 60 degrees.
Image 1: EXACT construction, ground-plan angle, narrow proportions and fixed-camera guide; replace its flat colors with painted building artwork.
Image 2: approved 0-degree factory; match its steep overhead viewpoint, grey slate texture, pale masonry, four saw-tooth bays and one round chimney.
The north/chimney end points UPPER RIGHT; the long axis runs from LOWER LEFT to UPPER RIGHT, shallow / diagonal.
Keep the camera direction and elevation FIXED to the approved 0-degree view: high overhead, roof-dominant, only very THIN wall strips. Do not use a low isometric camera. Re-render this single connected building at the guide's world orientation, never rotate a finished bitmap.
FOUR identical, orderly, parallel saw-tooth shed roof bays on ONE straight narrow rectangular perimeter. All ridge lines and gutter lines follow the same consistent construction. Real broad shallow grey roof slopes and steep narrow blue-grey northlight glazing; one continuous industrial factory, no domestic gables. Keep glazing on the same world-facing side, showing only surfaces visible from the fixed camera. No twisting, shearing, bent bays, fan-shaped roofs, tall glazed side facades, gigantic triangular walls, skewed chimney or distorted ends. The round chimney is screen-vertical in every orientation: opening directly above its base. Same roof pitch, wall height and bay proportions as the approved factory.
Preserve the exact shallow diagonal / vertical angle in image 1. All roofs, walls, eaves and chimney stay inside its THREE green hexes; opaque artwork covers ALL THREE yellow center dots. Keep the building slender and continuous. Do not widen the guide silhouette.
Final image: ONE complete isolated hand-painted tactical-game building with true alpha transparency and generous margins. Remove all guide hexes, dots, labels and background. No text, ground, glow, external shadow, extra buildings or detached objects.
